feature: Skip noncontributing volumetric cloud reflection rays on Forward+
status: Accepted source change on the qualified Forward+ volume path. No export, APK, delivery package or device installation.

implementation.dispatch: Gfx.compose invokes a pure source helper only inside the existing enabled enhanced-water cloud-reflection branch. The optimized placement requires Clouds.mode()>1 and forward_plus. Sheet, Mobile, Compatibility and unsupported compositions retain their exact legacy injection.
implementation.math: Preserve the original SSR call, confidence/weight arithmetic, fractional blending and final output. Delay the original cloud colour call until final reflection weight and opaque-screen confidence are known. Skip only exactly zero weight or exactly full SSR confidence, with no threshold.
implementation.quality: Unchanged density, ray samples (64/3 for reflected volume rays), light samples, precision, sky, shadow field and noise. Volume texture lookups already use explicit LOD; this branch introduces no implicit-derivative texture sampling.
implementation.ownership: No new GPU texture, history, cache or scene owner. Independent sky/shadow/reflection controls and opt-in defaults are unchanged.
implementation.fallback: If any expected composition marker is not unique, return the previous cloud-call injection.

performance.scope: 3840x2160 enhanced-water viewport GPU timestamps on Linux RTX3090 Ti; actual zone1/zone11 terrain, fixed low river camera, cloud reflections on, cloud shadows off, waves off, materials on. Sky background is plain colour, so this measures the scene with water-cloud reflections, not sky marching or whole-game FPS. No actors or authored scenery objects. The separate box scene adds an artificial opaque reflector.
performance.method: Sequential isolated ABBA: 2.5s preheat each complete program, 256 warm-up frames and 360 measured samples per arm. Same simulated cloud clock and inputs per arm, uncapped display. Report mean of two arm medians, with raw distributions and GPU/process logs retained.
performance.accepted_summary: Final exact production helper: zone1 mixed weather 4.4900 to 3.4845 ms (22.4% less). Source-equivalent prototypes: fair 20.6%, storm 19.6%, zone11 14.3%. Artificial reflector 57.7%; not representative of typical gameplay. SSR-off 0.36% difference, no speedup claim.

mask.meaning: Diagnostic unshaded ALBEDO RGB = full-confidence, zero-weight, water. Captured after all cost arms; its shader cost is excluded.

acceptance.image_scope: 108 paired 640x360 raw HDR image comparisons, plus held candidate and restored reference controls: qualities1/2/3 x SSR off/Natural/Mirror x static/rain+waves/level-offset/flat zero-weight case on three backends. Forward+ changes 24 cases; its sheet cases and all Mobile/Compatibility cases are unchanged-program controls. Vulkan FORMAT_RGBH (14), Compatibility FORMAT_RGBAF (11), not only 8-bit PNG comparisons. Pipeline counters are identical in the 27 authored-river states per backend. Flat-patch first use can compile new mesh/program variants during the warm-up intervals; those counts are retained, and every raw candidate/held/restored comparison remains exact.
acceptance.zero_weight_fixture: A controlled flat water patch above the real river uses the real water material and exact upward mesh normals, zero ripple array, waves/rain off and a distant orthographic camera. It covers all 230400 pixels with exactly zero final weight. Other cases use the real river plus a small opaque reflector; no shader math is rewritten for image comparisons. The diagnostic mask rewrites output only after comparisons.
acceptance.composition_scope: Complete current Gfx source loaded under a private class and used to recompose every registered shader from its original inputs. Existing PCK owns registrations, uniforms, cloud producers and cleanup. 81 Forward+ and 75 Mobile dispatches each assert full source equality with the qualified boundary and exact eligibility; Forward+ changes six invocations, Mobile zero. Rendered controls check settings labels/persistence/discard, independent sky/shadow/reflection images, shared noise, shadow producer/texture retirement, master off and original-water exclusion.

retained_rejections_and_fixture_failures.decision: Do not promote the High-sky sunlight-loop height exit. Mixed weather fails a strict held candidate image despite only about 2.9% measured cost reduction. Fair result also observes another headless engine during execution and is excluded from isolated timing claims. No production sky change; light_hdr.gd was prepared but never executed.

Do not enable the optimized Mobile variant. Two pixels differ, peak 2/255, while held, repeated and restored controls are exact. Mobile performance result is rejected. The cause is not established and this desktop volume difference is separate from the unresolved Adreno650 sheet/material-water flicker.

One original sheet restored-reference image differs before timed preheating. Optimized comparisons are exact. Retained failure; longer preheat final runs pass without changing the pixel criterion. Initial driver specialization is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated cause.

Image comparisons all pass; zero-weight coverage assertion fails (0 or7 pixels versus required >250). The first fixture mistakenly addressed ripple_amount, which is a varying; correcting the ripple array did not make authored river normals exactly flat. Replaced the edge case with an explicit controlled flat patch. Pixel equality checks and coverage threshold stay strict.
Headless UI-label checks fail nine width assertions. Excluded from layout acceptance; both rendered complete-composition settings tests pass all checks.

Early diagnostic masks put colour in EMISSION under unshaded mode and therefore rendered black. They are invalid coverage evidence, not performance images. Correct ALBEDO masks are used only for the final stated coverage counts.

runtime_and_delivery.engine_and_PCK: Reused /home/llm2x/Documents/EI/local/scratchpad/water-wave-empty-20261010/candidate01, unchanged a916f95 private PCK and engine. Source substitution qualifies the helper and full Gfx.compose boundary; not complete-current-source package acceptance.
runtime_and_delivery.android_this_change: No Android app changes or device runs. Android volume modes are unsupported by the existing constrained-platform policy, and the new production dispatch keeps the legacy sheet injection. No new Android first-load acceptance is claimed.
runtime_and_delivery.outstanding: Original RMX3890/Adreno610 first-load exit and Linux RTX3050/CachyOS report remain unresolved. Only Retroid Pocket5 is available; Windows/current-package and unavailable hardware acceptance remain open. Existing Adreno650 Mobile material-water flicker remains unresolved.
